get.summary: Lists events belonging to groups the authenticated user is a member of
Retrieves an event by its identifier (user must be a member of the event group)

401.description: Authentication required, invalid token, or user not a member of the event group

put.summary: Creates a new event (requires Entraineur role or above)

patch.summary: Partially updates an event (requires Entraineur role or above)

delete.summary: Deletes an event (requires Entraineur role or above)

get.summary: Retrieves a group by its identifier (requires Adhérent role or above)

put.summary: Creates a new group (requires Entraineur role or above)

patch.summary: Partially updates a group (requires Entraineur role or above)

404.description: Group or owner user not found

delete.summary: Deletes a group (requires Entraineur role or above)

get.summary: Lists the members of a group (requires Adhérent role or above)

put.summary: Adds a user to a group (requires Entraineur role or above)

409.description: User is already a member of the group

delete.summary: Removes a user from a group (requires Entraineur role or above)

404.description: Group, user, or membership not found
